# A line on a stock: units that leave offspring on a renewed level

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-line-on-a-stock` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](a-line-on-a-stock.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A way reads the level only by needs met. Capped at hi, nothing from nothing, positive needs met at first, each unit with kids, none needing more: if they together take more, the level is below a start need by step hi + 1; if the same, under the regime, the net never ends just where its course holds.

<a id="exact-statement--确切陈述"></a>
## Exact statement

A unit has a need, a use and the units it leaves; after a step at a level each unit of the way leaves its kids where the level meets its need and nothing where it does not, and the level is the regime's step under what the units present take together. With no premise on the stock, two levels that meet the same needs among a way's units leave the same next way, exactly so where every unit has a kid, and two courses from one way whose levels meet the same needs step by step have the same ways. With nothing given from nothing, the step under no use keeping the level within hi, each unit's kids together taking more than it, every descendant needing something and a start not empty, at most hi, with every need met, a first unmet need comes within hi + 1 steps, the way until then the generation of descent; with kids needing no more than their parent the level there is below a need the start met, and, with every unit's need positive as well, the net ends, with no bound on the step. Where each unit's kids together take exactly what it takes, every unit has kids and kids need no more than their parent, with nothing given from nothing, every descendant needing something and the start at most hi, under the regime along the course, the net never ends exactly where its course comes, some need met at every step before, to a configuration that holds.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A unit has a need, a use and the units it leaves (kids); a way is a list of units. after w x: each unit of w in turn leaves its kids where x meets its need and nothing where it does not; taken w is the total of the uses of the units present; left is RegimeMargin.step giving (taken w) x. Goes: some unit's need is met; net is Law.stepWhile Goes of TurningInTime.pair after left; course is the pair's orbit. <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Discrete steps; any type of units, each with a need, a use and the list of units it leaves; a way is a list of units, repeats kept and counted; whole-number levels; one giving, a function of what is left after the take, the same for every way.
- The level's step is RegimeMargin.step giving (taken use w): what every unit present at the step takes, summed, is taken first and as much as there is, and giving is added from what is left. A unit whose need the level meets leaves its kids; one whose need it does not meet leaves nothing.
- The alikeness laws (after_alike, alike_iff, ways_alike, born_alike) and never_in, gone_from, takes_nothing and account ask nothing of the giving; the first seven have no premise on the stock, and account asks that what the way takes is at most the level at every step before N. alike_iff asks that every unit of the way has a kid; never_in and gone_from that no unit outside the line leaves a unit of it; takes_nothing that the units of Z take nothing and leave only units of Z.
- The cap: the step under no use keeps every level up to hi within hi (RegimeMargin.Keeps giving 0 hi), the start at most hi; and nothing given from nothing (RegimeMargin.FromNothing giving). need_unmet, falls_to_unmet, way_ends, line_ends and one_need_ends take both; taken_below, unending_taken_below and account_unending take nothing given from nothing without the cap.
- Each unit's kids together take more than it (grows): asked of every unit for need_unmet, falls_to_unmet, way_ends and one_need_ends; for line_ends, each unit of a closed line has kids of the line that together take more than it. For fall: a closed line of one need m, each unit with kids of the line that together take no less than it, giving 0 below m, and the line taking at the start more than every giving.
- Kids needing no more than their parent (down), for falls_to_unmet, way_ends, line_ends and unending_iff_holds; positive needs: every descendant of the start's way needing something (Needing) for need_unmet, falls_to_unmet, unending_iff_holds and taken_below, every unit for way_ends, every unit of the line for line_ends; one positive need for every unit for one_need_ends. need_unmet asks the start not empty with every need met.
- For unending_iff_holds: each unit's kids together taking exactly what it takes (even), every unit having kids, down, Needing, nothing given from nothing, the start at most hi, and Regime (Short, Meets and Keeps at what the way takes, with y of it, up to hi) at every way the course reaches with some need met there and at every step before. The regime along the course is assumed, not derived.
- The needs, uses and offspring, y and hi are parameters given with the carrier; nothing makes a new kind or changes kids. FromNothing, Keeps, Short, Meets and Regime are premises on the giving, as in TurningInTime and WayOfUnits.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- An exact condition for a way whose units' kids together take more, or less, never ending; with one way, whether the net ends is not monotone in the start level. Witness: `Becoming.LineOnAStock.HigherStartEnds.higher_ends`.
- That the level has fallen at the first unmet need of need_unmet: without down the unmet need can be a kid's greater need at a level that has not fallen. Witness: `Becoming.LineOnAStock.KidHigherNeed.all_but_down`.
- That the net ends at the first unmet need of need_unmet: not concluded, since a unit of another need may still be met; no kept countermodel, and in KidHigherNeed the net does end there.
- That units which take nothing make no difference to whether the net ends: they leave the levels as they are, and can change the ending. Witness: `Becoming.LineOnAStock.NothingTakenEnds.ending_differs`.
- A new kind, or a way that comes to read the fall because of the fall: needs, uses and offspring are given, and no new difference arrives from a difference not yet made.
- That the alikeness laws meet the stock: they hold with no premise on it, and meet the laws that need it only through every need being met.
- Anything about the two built examples beyond their sizes and levels: each ending already follows from the example's own Lean, and the organisms' identities and the need are not equated.
- Anything about a trained system, or that any actual course has this model's form.
- **Counterexample:** Against way_ends without down: on min z (10 − z) with hi = 10, a unit needing four whose kids include one needing nine, every other premise holding, the configuration ([B, A, B], 8) is left as it is and the net never ends (KidsNeedMore.all_but_down). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LineOnAStock.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Against reading need_unmet as a fall: on min z (12 − z) from ([A], 12), every premise of need_unmet holding and down failing, the unmet need after one step is that of the kids B, B at twelve, a level that has not fallen (KidHigherNeed.all_but_down). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LineOnAStock.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Against way_ends with a unit's kids together taking the same in place of more: one unit needing one, taking one and leaving itself, from ([()], 12) on min z (12 − z), every other premise holding, never ends (EqualInPlaceOfMore.all_but_grows). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LineOnAStock.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Against a monotone fate in the start level: from ([A], 6) the net never ends and from ([A], 7) it ends, the ways the same at steps 0 to 2 (HigherStartEnds.higher_ends). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LineOnAStock.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Against alike_iff without every unit having a kid: levels four and six are alike to [d, b], d needing five and leaving nothing, and do not meet the same needs in it (AlikeFiner.alike_not_met). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LineOnAStock.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Against units that take nothing making no difference to the ending: with nothing given, the levels from ([A], 5) and ([A, C], 5) are the same at every step, the first net ends after one step and the second never ends (NothingTakenEnds.ending_differs). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LineOnAStock.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Against every need met while the net goes on: a met unit with no kids, from one unit at twelve, leaves the empty way one step later and the net ends with every need met at the start (NoKids.ends_met). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LineOnAStock.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out. · A conditional law does not make its antecedent universal; a theorem's premise is not thereby necessary for every achievement.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Reading (AI-written, from the study note): falls_to_unmet is this model's form of a going-on that draws down what it rests on while nothing in it yet differs. Until the first unmet need the way at each step is the generation of descent, in which no giving, use or level appears; by then the level is below a need the start met. That reading rests on what the law takes as given: nothing given from nothing, the cap, each unit's kids together taking more than it (grows), every descendant needing something, a start not empty with every need met, and down; without down the level need not have fallen (KidHigherNeed). The two built examples, MultiplyingTakers and the gated Drain, match courses of this model in sizes and levels only. No near work was read for this item beyond turning-in-time's.
